1.web: The burden of the wilderness of the sea. As whirlwinds in the South sweep through, it comes from the wilderness, from an awesome land.
1.asv: The burden of the wilderness of the sea. As whirlwinds in the South sweep through, it cometh from the wilderness, from a terrible land.

2.web: A grievous vision is declared to me. The treacherous man deals treacherously, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam; attack! I have stopped all of Media’s sighing.
2.asv: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous man dealeth treacherously, and the destroyer destroyeth. Go up, O Elam; besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.

3.web: Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have taken hold on me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much pain that I can’t hear. I so am dismayed that I can’t see.
3.asv: Therefore are my loins filled with anguish; pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman in travail: I am pained so that I cannot hear; I am dismayed so that I cannot see.

4.web: My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.
4.asv: My heart fluttereth, horror hath affrighted me; the twilight that I desired hath been turned into trembling unto me.

5.web: They prepare the table. They set the watch. They eat. They drink. Rise up, you princes, oil the shield!
5.asv: They prepare the table, they set the watch, they eat, they drink: rise up, ye princes, anoint the shield.

6.web: For the Lord said to me, “Go, set a watchman. Let him declare what he sees.
6.asv: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Go, set a watchman; let him declare what he seeth:

7.web: When he sees a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of donkeys, a troop of camels, he shall listen diligently with great attentiveness.”
7.asv: and when he seeth a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of asses, a troop of camels, he shall hearken diligently with much heed.

8.web: He cried like a lion: “Lord, I stand continually on the watchtower in the daytime, and every night I stay at my post.
8.asv: And he cried as a lion: O Lord, I stand continually upon the watch-tower in the day-time, and am set in my ward whole nights;

9.web: Behold, here comes a troop of men, horsemen in pairs.” He answered, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the engraved images of her gods are broken to the ground.
9.asv: and, behold, here cometh a troop of men, horsemen in pairs. And he answered and said, Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the graven images of her gods are broken unto the ground.

10.web: You are my threshing, and the grain of my floor!” That which I have heard from Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, I have declared to you.
10.asv: O thou my threshing, and the grain of my floor! that which I have heard from Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.

11.web: The burden of Dumah. One calls to me out of Seir, “Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?”
11.asv: The burden of Dumah. One calleth unto me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?

12.web: The watchman said, “The morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire. Come back again.”
12.asv: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will inquire, inquire ye: turn ye, come.

13.web: The burden on Arabia. In the forest in Arabia you will lodge, you caravans of Dedanites.
13.asv: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye caravans of Dedanites.

14.web: They brought water to him who was thirsty. The inhabitants of the land of Tema met the fugitives with their bread.
14.asv: Unto him that was thirsty they brought water; the inhabitants of the land of Tema did meet the fugitives with their bread.

15.web: For they fled away from the swords, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow, and from the heat of battle.
15.asv: For they fled away from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.

16.web: For the Lord said to me, “Within a year, as a worker bound by contract would count it, all the glory of Kedar will fail,
16.asv: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of a hireling, all the glory of Kedar shall fail;

17.web: and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, will be few; for Yahweh, the God of Israel, has spoken it.”
17.asv: and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be few; for Jehovah, the God of Israel, hath spoken it.
